evidence: We also offer additional add-on technology solutions to support our clients and drive engagement, such as a conversational AI engine for customers of banks and financial institutions, and a real-time payment risk platform which employs AI and machine learning technology to enhance payment fraud mitigation strategies for financial customers.

ai_positioning.summary: SoFi intègre l'IA dans ses produits (moteur conversationnel, plateforme de détection de fraude) et ses processus métier, tout en adoptant une posture prudente face aux risques réglementaires émergents et aux obligations de conformité.
